sourceAudit: All 66 own skill icon slots checked empty. Existing skill panora­mas from 110–118 already reviewed; new compact icons retain semantic subjects and use the established transparent cel-shaded language. Covers preserved.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE compact original game UI icon for a fictional 2045 cyberpunk RPG. Polished graphic 2D CEL SHADING with thick continuous deep-plum contour, finer sparse inner lines, broad clean color planes and two-step matte shading. Restrained teal, burgundy, graphite, cream and amber palettes. Complete bold silhouette legible at 48 px. Center on square, even 10% safe margins. GENUINE transparent alpha outside subject. No text, logos, background, tile, frame, cast shadow, glowing halo or detached particles, no photorealism or 3D. Subject: two teal game dice with plain circular pips resting against one amber credit chip, simple tabletop gambling emblem.
assets.exportRecipe: Alpha bounds above 8/255 (ignore near-invisible generator edge specks), original alpha preserved, Lanczos3 contain in 112 px plus 8 px transparent safe margin, lossless RGBA WebP; no creative edits

visualReview.note: Reviewed the 128/64 px dark/light exports: clear skill silhouette, cel shading, true alpha, complete subject and no labels.
